findings.note: Point-of-use only. The feat is passive text with no number to compute: the whole clause is a rider on ANOTHER record's action row, which is exactly what recordMarks (on:'action') carries — MainTab.tsx:697 calls recordMarkersFor(character, content, 'action', actionId(a.name)) for every action row, and actions/mobbing-assault is on the sheet via feats/necrologist-dedication.grantsActions. No situationalBonuses entry: the off-guard lands on the FOE, so a star on the holder's own statistic would promise a bonus they never get.

findings.note: The BONUS half already ships (situationalBonuses.ts:1117, +1 circumstance to AC and to all saves) and is left untouched.
